title: Artemisia absinthium cream for medicinal use
intro: Artemisia absinthium cream is a topical herbal preparation made from the dried leaves and flowers of the wormwood plant. It is traditionally used in herbalism to treat skin conditions such as eczema, psoriasis, and fungal infections due to its antifungal and anti-inflammatory properties. The cream is often applied directly to the affected area to soothe irritation and promote healing. It is also believed to help with digestive issues when used internally, though it is more commonly applied externally. This preparation is valued for its natural compounds that support skin health and immune function.
